author: Pxx500
name: NHModeration
install_msg: Thank you for installing NHModeration. Run `[p]nhmod` in a private moderator channel to get started.
short: Store moderation history, render BanChart, and filter configured phrases.
description: Import and retain moderation evidence in SQLite, reconcile missed ban events, render a local BanChart, and delete messages containing configured phrases.
end_user_data_statement: NHModeration stores source observations and canonical moderation actions in SQLite. Observations may contain guild, target, technical executor, credited moderator, and channel IDs, action type, timestamps, reasons, expiry, source identity, migration run identity, and attribution hints. Available account snapshots include usernames, global names, nicknames, creation and membership join dates, bot/system and public flags, with observation provenance. Live ban observations may retain bounded NHMisc activity counts, time windows and coverage. No avatars or message copies are added. It also stores synchronization cursors, migration state, and operational failure records. Ordinary user and strict-user requests remove the target's optional account and activity snapshots while preserving necessary moderation reasons, identifiers, and history. A request from a moderator does not remove another target's reasons. Explicit owner or deleted-account requests anonymize matching identities and reasons, remove the subject's snapshots, then rebuild affected projections. Guild removal deletes that guild's history, synchronization state, migration state, failures, and configuration. Exported copies cannot be retroactively scrubbed. Tracebacks are written to the Python logger and are not stored in SQLite.
